title: Fireball Jutsu
body:
Syntax: perform fireball jutsu <target>

Description: A Ninjutsu jutsu, unlocked at level 20. 24-29 damage, with a 40% chance to also set the target Burning -- steady damage each round for a few rounds. Costs 20 Chakra, 5 second cooldown.

Requires your own chakra nature (primary or secondary) to genuinely be Fire -- this jutsu cannot be cast at all otherwise, even if it shows up in your learned skills. See 'help channel' for how to discover your chakra nature.

Date: 2026-08-24
